props.covers: The durable SyncState shape, status vocabulary, and coexistence invariants for one sync workflow.

text.insert: SyncState records an initial or manual Sync request, from observed intake through staging and publication. It holds resumable progress and blockers. Harness State separately records the game's accepted source and readiness. Dispatch State controls the lease.

fields.name: intake
fields.description: What this sync ingests. Captured when the operator starts sync.

fields.name: upstream_from
fields.description: harness head's upstream anchor before sync.

fields.name: upstream_to
fields.description: Observed upstream target. Equals upstream_from on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: corpus_batch_ids
fields.description: Operator-supplied observation metadata. V2 Discord intake reads the configured archive at publication.

fields.name: knowledge_only
fields.description: True when upstream did not move. Source reconciliation is skipped and V2 intake still runs.

fields.name: staging
fields.description: Isolated workspace where all reconciliation happens; null on a knowledge-only pass. Carries commits_behind, merge_in_progress, merge_policy, last_durable_stage (workspace_created | harness_merged | pr_series_reconciled | validated), conflicting_paths.

fields.name: pr_reconciliation
fields.description: One entry per open PR series merged alongside the harness (policy merge, same as the epoch boundary).

fields.name: pushed
fields.description: True once the reconciled branch is pushed to its upstream PR at publish.

fields.name: publication
fields.description: Recorded at the durable boundary after V2 intake succeeds against the canonical publication checkout.

fields.name: remote_application_id
fields.description: Boundary recorded in the harness timeline; absent on a knowledge-only pass.

fields.name: knowledge_intake
fields.description: V2 reconciliation, citation re-anchoring, and importer results.

props.name: SyncState

text.insert: Staging and per-series outcomes identify resumable work, blockers explain required intervention, and publication identifies the accepted boundary. The game ID resolves harness ownership. Knowledge-only Sync runs intake against the canonical harness worktree without moving source head. Source-changing Sync uses the configured per-function merge policy.

rows: Intake is observed but not started.
No lease is held and no protected state changes.
Sync stages source and knowledge inputs.
Canonical source and knowledge truth remain unchanged.
Staging merges upstream into the harness branch with the policy merge and reconciles open PR series the same way.
Publication cannot start without successful evidence.
Evidence is complete and awaits confirmation.
Confirmed records and branch updates are being committed.
Cancellation is unavailable; recovery moves forward.
The boundary and required pushes are durable; the knowledge intake has run against the new harness head.
Sync is terminal and releases authority.
Lease and recoverable state are preserved when active.
Staging is discarded and harness worktree is unchanged.
props.title: Sync status semantics

text.insert: requires a committed publication record and completed pushes. Automatic epoch Sync records its boundary in Harness State and the Run history instead of traversing these manual statuses.
